title: Normal sinus rhythm
note: A healthy-looking rhythm: regular P-QRS-T complexes at 60-100 bpm. Start here.

title: Right bundle branch block
note: Wide, notched QRS complexes. Still a normal (N) beat in AAMI terms because it starts in the sinus node.

title: Ventricular bigeminy
note: Every other beat is a premature ventricular contraction (PVC): wide, bizarre, early, then a pause.

title: Frequent multiform PVCs
note: Many PVCs with different shapes, including couplets and short runs.

title: Fusion beats
note: A ventricular and a normal beat fire at the same time and merge into a hybrid shape (F). Hard for any classifier.

title: Atrial fibrillation
note: No P waves and an 'irregularly irregular' rhythm. Each beat is normal, so the rhythm analysis must catch it.

title: Bradycardia, APCs and long pauses
note: Slow ectopic atrial rhythm with pauses of several seconds. The abnormal beats are the patient's *usual* rhythm here, which defeats classifiers that compare beats with the patient's norm.

title: 2:1 heart block
note: Every second P wave is not conducted, halving the ventricular rate. Watch the long, regular RR intervals.

title: Heavy real-world noise
note: Large muscle and motion artifacts from an ambulatory recording. A stress test for filtering and detection.

title: Supraventricular tachycardia
note: Bursts of rapid supraventricular (S) beats. This patient was in the training set (DS1).
